releaseNotes:
Official Release v1.3.133:
- LIQUOR SUBCATEGORY PRESETS: Automatic out-of-the-box support for official bar liquor categories (Cognac, Tequila, Whiskey, Vodka, Rum, Gin, Mezcal, Cordials, Champagne).
- TOUCH-FRIENDLY SUB-TAB ASSIGNMENT: Instant one-tap pill buttons in product quick editor to assign bottles directly to Cognac or other categories without manual typing.
- PURE BOTTLE INVENTORY: Removed redundant price fields from alcohol & commercial scale control, dedicating screen 100% to fluid ounces, bottle counts, and weight calibration.
- PERSISTENT DIRECTION CONTROLS: Fixed product reordering and sub-tab reordering via centralized database transactions with boundary toasts.
- 100% Quality Standard: 0 errors and 0 warnings verified across all integrity auditors.
